hooks.description: Warn when writing implementation code outside ./build/ in a pipeline project
hooks.command: file=$(echo "$COPILOT_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); files=d.get('files',[]); [print(f.get('filePath','')) for f in files]" 2>/dev/null); for f in $file; do if echo "$f" | grep -qE 'PROJECTS/[^/]+/' && ! echo "$f" | grep -qE 'PROJECTS/[^/]+/(build/|[0-9]-|6-TEST|7-BUG|testresults/|[a-z_]+_test_pipeline|goal\.md|annotate_)'; then echo "WARNING: Writing to '$f' which is outside ./build/ and not a pipeline artifact. Confirm this is intentional."; fi; done; exit 0
